groups.label: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.
groups.printed: One unit in your army with the Character special rule may be selected as a warlord. A warlord may purchase a single Warlord Trait for free.

choices.name: Rites of Battle
choices.text: If your Warlord has this trait, you can increase the number of Elite Slots, Fast Attack Slots or Heavy Support slots in your army by 1.

choices.name: Storm of Fire
choices.text: Once per game during the shooting phase, your Warlord and any unit they are attached to gains the Rending (5+) special rule on all of their shooting weapons until the end of that shooting phase.

choices.name: The Imperium's Sword
choices.text: The Warlord gains +1 to its Strength (S) and Attacks (A) Characteristics.

groups.label: Any Space marine unit with the Psyker (x) special rule may purchase Psychic Powers from the following Discipline:
groups.printed: Any Space marine unit with the Pysker (x) special rule may purchase Psychic Powers from the following Discipline:
groups.name: Librarius Psychic Powers

choices.name: Iron Arm
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker gains +2 to its Strength (S) Characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Null Zone
choices.text: When this power is cast, enemy units within 12" of the Psyker may not make Invulnerable Saves until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Psychic Fortress
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and all friendly units within 12" of them gain a 6+ Invulnerable Save until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Smite
choices.text:
The Psyker gains the following Psychic Weapon:

- Smite

choices.name: Veil of Time
choices.text: When this power is cast, the Psyker and any attached unit gain +1 to their Charge Rolls and Initiative (I) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

groups.label: Any Space marine unit with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following Prayers:
groups.printed: Any Space marine unit with the Priest (x) special rule may purchase the following Prayers:
groups.name: Litany of Prayers

choices.name: Litany of Focus
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit has the Indomitable Spirit (4+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Hatred
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Rage
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain the Fear (1) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Litany of Strength
choices.text: When this Prayer is performed, the Priest and any attached unit gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

groups.label: Any Space marine unit with the Battle Smith (x) special rule may purchase the following Machine Rites:
groups.printed: Any Space marine unit with the Battle Smith (x) special rule may purchase the following Machine Rites:
groups.name: Machine Rites

choices.name: Rite of Consecration
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6" of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit gains the Indomitable Spirit (6+) special rule until the start of your next Shooting Phase.

choices.name: Rite of Immolation
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6" of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit immediately suffers an Explodes result per the Vehicle Damage Chart, even if it would normally not.

choices.name: Rite of Reloading
choices.text: When this Rite is performed successfully, select 1 friendly Walker, Automata, Vehicle, Knight, Fortification or Aircraft unit within 6" of the unit performing this Rite or the unit performing the Rite is embarked upon. That unit immediately makes a Shooting Attack with 1 weapon it is equipped with.

choices.name: Rite of Repair
choices.text:
When this Rite is performed successfully, select one of the following effects:

- Select 1 Walker or Automata unit either within 3" or attached to the unit that is performing this rite. The target unit Heals 1 wound.
- Select 1 Vehicle, Aircraft, Knight or Fortification either within 3", attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon. Select 1 weapon that target unit is equipped with that has been destroyed. The chosen weapon is no longer destroyed.
- Select 1 Vehicle or Knight either within 3", attached to the unit performing this Rite or that this unit is embarked upon that is immobilized. That unit is no longer immobilized. If the unit has the Super Heavy (x) special rule and was Limping, it is no longer considered to be Limping.

groups.label: You may select 1 Predator Tank or Gladiator Tank in your army to be upgraded to a Tank Commander. That Tank Commander gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS), Attacks (A) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. The Tank Commander must be your Warlord. It gains the Character Keyword.
groups.printed: You may select 1 Predator Tank or Gladiator Tank in your army to be upgraded to a Tank Commander. That Tank Commander gains +1 to its Ballistic Skill (BS), Attacks (A) and Leadership (LD) characteristics. The Tank Commander must be your Warlord. It gains the Character Keyword.

groups.label: You may select one Space Marine Infantry or Bike unit that does not have the Veteran keyword to include in your army. It gains the Veteran keyword.
groups.printed: You may select one Space Marine Infantry or Bike unit that does not have the Veteran keyword to include in your army. It gains the Veteran keyword.
